thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT — elevated 5xx + timeouts from inference gateway (us-east-1). Error rate jumped from 4% -> 58% over 5m for /v1/generate on model opt-13b-quant. Graph: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abc123

sre_oncall_maria: I'm paged, taking initial triage. tagging runtime team and ops. starting data collection.

runtime_alex: I see the spike. pulling logs from model-runner pool 'mr-us-east-12'.

runtime_alex: logs show repeated crashes and OOMs, then segfaults during kv-cache replay. snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T12:03:45Z] model-runner[pid=23456]: Alloc failed for 2.1GiB at kv_cache_replay
[2026-03-17T12:03:46Z] model-runner[pid=23456]: SIGSEGV @ 0x7f8a3c2b
[2026-03-17T12:03:47Z] kernel: oom-kill: killing process 23456 (model-runner) score 987
```

ops_satya: Noted. Are the affected pods autoscaled or preemptible? can we cordon the host? :eyes:

sre_oncall_maria: Affected are both shared hosted and a few dedicated pools. Starting quick impact check.

support_lina: CS: two enterprise customers report 5xxs on GA endpoints; one opened a Sev1 ticket (#SEV-4521). Many more minor errors logged.

product_jake: Any customers on Dedicated with SLA risk?

support_lina: One dedicated tenant (acme-inc) hit 40% error rate, routed through ded-pool-9. They pinged their AE.

runtime_alex: Hypothesis: recent quantized attention kernel path regressed under long prefix cases. Reproducer: send long context (8k tokens) repeatedly and watch mem growth.

ops_satya: Immediate mitigations I can run now:
- scale up model-runner replicas by +30% on mr-us-east-12
- cordon and drain host gnr-12 (suspected of hitting kernel oom)
- enable gateway fallback to opt-13b-fp16 (lower mem profile)

sre_oncall_maria: Do the fallback + cordon. I'll patch LB to route new sessions away from mr-us-east-12.

runtime_alex: Starting automated fallback policy: routing 100% of new traffic for model opt-13b-quant -> opt-13b-fp16 for us-east for now. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: ACTION — gateway fallback activated by runtime_alex at 1777777018.

ops_satya: Cordon gnr-12 and restart runners on other nodes. Running drain now.

support_lina: Confirming customer updates: CS notified acme-inc and queued mitigation steps. No billing impact yet, but API errors are affecting realtime features.

product_jake: Please capture latency and quality delta on fallback model and flag regressions. We need to decide whether to keep fallback or rollback kernel change.

runtime_alex: Capturing perf: fallback reduces median latency by ~5ms but slightly lower logprob on long contexts. I'll run quick eval on our canary prompt set.

sre_oncall_maria: Next steps:
1) Keep fallback active and monitor 15m
2) Collect full core/stack traces from oom hosts and upload to /incidents/1777777000/artifacts
3) If crashes persist after cordon, roll forward a hotfix reverting recent attention kernel change

ops_satya: cordon + restart done on gnr-12. New runners on mr-us-east-14 picked up traffic. Error rate dropping from 58% -> 9% in last 4m.

incident-bot: NOTE — on-call handoff: runtime_alex is now primary at 1777777030 (duration: 2h) :pager: 

support_lina: CS updated acme-inc that temporary fallback is live; they will test critical flows and report.

runtime_alex: Uploading logs and core dumps to /incidents/1777777000/artifacts (s3://redwood-incident/1777777000/). Running bisect on last kernel change.

product_jake: If we keep fallback >1h, prepare comms and PSIRT assessment for any customers with degraded quality.

sre_oncall_maria: Will monitor; escalating to runtime lead if errors rebound. tagging follow-up: postmortem + remediation plan.

ops_satya: error rate now stable ~6%. continuing observation. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigation in place, partial recovery observed. Next update due in 15m or on any spike.
